description: This file contains Django REST Framework views and serializers for handling JWT authentication, including a custom serializer for login with username or email, and a debug endpoint.

classes.name: UsernameOrEmailTokenObtainPairSerializer
classes.description: Custom serializer allowing login via username or email, extending JWT token serializer.

classes.name: UsernameOrEmailTokenObtainPairView
classes.description: API view for obtaining JWT tokens with flexible login credentials.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates login credentials, resolving email or username, and handles error normalization.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles POST request to issue JWT tokens, logs request path, and normalizes response status.

methods.name: debug_auth_endpoint
methods.description: GET endpoint for debugging auth URL resolution, echoes request info.
